title: Relay wake diagnostics and descriptor-error listing fallback hide deferred failures
outcome: Expose bounded relay-worker failure diagnostics and distinguish genuine missing federation identity from listing failures without silently omitting relay history.
acceptance: Controlled worker failures produce bounded non-secret diagnostics identifying failed operation and status without raw bodies, tokens or locator leakage.
A genuine standalone root still lists its mailboxes, while a non-identity descriptor/store failure is not silently represented as verified empty relay history.
